stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 cherry-pick [--continue|--abort] [-m <parent-number>] [<commit>]

Apply the changes introduced by an existing commit.

Examples:
  git2 cherry-pick <commit>
  git2 cherry-pick -m 1 <merge-commit>
  git2 cherry-pick --continue
  git2 cherry-pick --abort

Options:
    --continue
        continue an in-progress cherry-pick
    --abort
        abort an in-progress cherry-pick
    -m <parent-number>, --mainline=<parent-number>
        select mainline parent for merge commits
    <commit>
        commit to cherry-pick
